propositions: Blocking LINK events written before comparability became structural remain durable and unresolved on read, distorting ready/next-batch and parent-first cascade when an edge should now sit between different tickets.
A store-wide scan must classify each net-active blocking edge as ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable by comparing the recorded pair against the current resolver output.

The --repair mode writes the replacement LINK before removing the stale one to ensure no dependency is lost if interrupted, declines ambiguous-pair repairs, and refuses to run while a reconciler pass is in flight.
Read-only runs must not trigger store reconverge (init_only=True), while --repair runs reconverge the store (init_only=False).
Residual mis-escalated edges whose resolved source is closed are inert and cannot appear in ready/next-batch, so they do not affect scheduling even when unrepaired.
